https://dev.roost.ai.core_purpose: The site provides automated environments for software development and testing, enabling users to rapidly deploy, test, and iterate on applications in isolated, dynamic environments.
business_requirements: Users must be able to create and manage isolated testing environments for software applications.
Users must be able to deploy applications into testing environments with minimal manual configuration.
Users must be able to schedule automated testing workflows to validate application functionality and performance.
Users must be able to monitor and track the status and performance of all active environments and tests in real-time.
Users must be able to integrate external repositories or CI/CD pipelines to streamline the deployment process.
Users must be able to clone existing environments to replicate specific conditions for testing purposes.
Users must be able to configure environment settings such as resource allocation and dependencies to match specific use cases.
